# Welcome to the Course!

#### Course: Build your First Web App with React

## Welcome to the Course!

Hello there 👋 And welcome to this React Fundamentals course!

If you're an aspiring frontend developer and are proficient in the basics of JavaScript, this course is for you.

Throughout this course, I'll teach you the basics of JavaScript's React library by building a functional and useful React app step by step.

Basically, you'll build a Daily Journal App where users can write, edit, and delete entries.

![Your Final React Project](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

But before teaching you about React, I want to borrow some of your time to clarify a few more things.

So please click the Next Lesson button to proceed.
